lede_html: Tenders slipped to 27 from 30 this week while awards edged up to 58. Most of the power hardware went to one supplier: Siemens Energy took the US$240m Austrian 380-220kV transformer award and the US$161m Łagisza turbine islands in Poland. Outside Europe, Chinese contractors won the US$416m Mazoon copper mining contract in Oman and a World Bank-funded dam in Uganda. If you buy transformers or turbines, qualify a second supplier early, because the market leader is filling its order book now.

deals_why.Mazoon Copper Project: A 10-year, US$416m-plus mining contract for Chinese contractor Hongda Blasting gives Oman's MDO an operator for Mazoon and keeps Hongda's crews booked there for a decade.
deals_why.Extension of dock 9 and filling of dock: Málaga's port authority is buying about US$54m of quay and fill works; marine contractors have until 10 December to bid.
deals_why.550 MVA Trafobänke 380-220kV: At US$240m, this Austrian 380-220kV transformer award puts a large block of Siemens Energy's high-voltage capacity on one grid order.
deals_why.Gas turbines - Supply of two turbine isl: Siemens Energy's US$161m award for two turbine islands shows Poland is still buying gas-fired generation, and it adds to the order book of a supplier already busy this week.
deals_why.Cardellino overhead line installation ve: An US$84m award to Tesmec Rail for overhead line installation vehicles shows Swiss rail is putting serious money into its own catenary-building plant.
deals_why.Gas pipelines - Segarcea - Băilești – Ca: Splitting US$50m into three lots spread the work across a Romanian contractor group that includes Habau, which keeps several local pipeline crews busy at once.
deals_why.Construction of methane fermentation ins: MTM's US$33m win shows Polish waste operators are paying for biogas-and-compost plants as single build packages, not as separate process contracts.
deals_why.S for Kabuyanda Earth Dam in Isingiro Di: China Gezhouba's US$28.7m World Bank-financed win in Uganda confirms that Chinese contractors remain the price to beat on multilateral-funded dam work.
deals_why.Underwater pipelines Colonnella and Rode: A Fincantieri Infrastructure-led group took this US$28m Italian subsea pipeline job, so its marine spread is committed on the Adriatic coast for now.
deals_why.Medium-voltage switchboards – prj_129276: Spreading US$26m across ABB, Boffetti, IMESA and Siemens suggests the buyer wants several qualified sources rather than reliance on one switchboard maker.
deals_why.Parts of electricity distribution or con: A US$24m call-off to Schneider Electric Austria ties future protection equipment orders to an existing framework, leaving little room for newcomers in this round.
deals_why.Replacement of pipelines and new gas dis: Four regional lots worth US$22m went to separate local firms, which shows Romanian distribution upgrades are being let in pieces that suit smaller contractors.

flows_why.https://www.rigzone.com/news/wire/uae_mu: The UAE is considering a third export pipeline that bypasses Hormuz, which points to more crude loading outside the Strait and to pipeline work for contractors to watch.
